enchantments.tooltip: Minor Turning: Increases total number of Turn Undead uses by 1, once wielder rests. If you unequip the item you will lose these turns.
Healing Lore III: Passive: Your Positive Energy spells gain a 13% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Wizardry II: This item grants the wearer +50 maximum spell points. Sorcerers and Favored Souls gain up to double spell points from items.
